Package org.osgi.impl.service.rest.resources

Class AbstractOSGiResource<T>

java.lang.Object
org.restlet.resource.Resource
org.restlet.resource.UniformResource
org.restlet.resource.ServerResource
org.osgi.impl.service.rest.resources.AbstractOSGiResource<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the pojo base class which is reflected by the pojo reflector.
Direct Known Subclasses:
BundleHeaderResource, BundleRepresentationsResource, BundleResource, BundlesResource, BundleStartLevelResource, BundleStateResource, ExtensionsResource, FrameworkStartLevelResource, ServiceListResource, ServiceRepresentationsResource, ServiceResource
public class AbstractOSGiResource<T> extends org.restlet.resource.ServerResource
Abstract OSGi resource with the functionality to translate OSGi entities to representations according to requested media types (variants).
Author:
Jan S. Rellermeyer, IBM Research
